rules: Enter when 2+ signals align: breakout, momentum leader, oversold snapback, dated catalyst.

18% trailing stop on every entry. Never remove a stop.
Daily halt at −8% equity loss; monthly kill-switch at −25% MTD.
Max 8 open positions. Max 60% per sector. Keep ~10% cash buffer.
